cohort: 128,536 patients who underwent in-hospital non-cardiac surgeries
finding: Leucocyte count, haemoglobin, and the revised cardiac risk index (RCRI) score were significantly associated with pTTS.
mod_finding: Caesarean section has the highest proportion of pTTS (30% of the pTTS cases) with the incidence of caesarean section-related pTTS of 0.06% in our centre.
